claims.text: After his death, his sons Thrór and Grór led most of the Dwarves of Durin's folk east. Thrór, along with Borin his uncle, led one group back to the Lonely Mountain, while Grór founded his own realm in the Iron Hills.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "Durin's Folk", p. 1072
